d: Vinicius Junior is dealing with a difficult spell at Real Madrid. A four-match ban means he will miss El Clasico at La Liga, while the reaction from the Santiago Bernabeu crowd has added to the scrutiny around the Brazilian forward. Jose Mourinho's comments have also brought their relationship into focus. Rupha Ramani looks at what's changing for Vinicius at Madrid and why his situation has become about more than football.
